name: 44313 · Akron, OH
findings: ZIP 44313 (Akron) has 150 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44313 (Akron) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44313 (Akron) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
